name: University of Edinburgh
summary: Scotland's capital and about 330 undergraduate degrees; most take four years, with a range of subjects in years 1 and 2 before you specialise.

handoff.label: Undergraduate degrees A to Z (2027 entry)

ib.text: Each degree gives a points total and three HL grades, e.g. 34 with 655 for Ancient History, 37–40 with 666–766 plus HL Maths 5 for Economics. You need at least 5 in SL English unless a degree asks for more.

dates.label: UCAT (Medicine): last day to sit the test
UCAS deadline for Medicine and Veterinary Medicine, 18:00 UK time
UCAS equal consideration deadline (most degrees), 18:00 UK time
Veterinary Medicine: Work Experience Summary form and transcript due

programmes.name: Computer Science
programmes.about: How computing systems are designed, built and used, from the maths and logic of what can be computed to programming real problems. No programming is assumed; years 1 and 2 leave room for other subjects before you specialise.
programmes.ib: Offers in recent years ran from 43 points with 777 at HL to 34 with 665. Maths AA HL 6 is required (AI is not accepted), and English SL 5.
programmes.selectionNote: Apply to one Computer Science degree only. Meeting the requirements puts you in selection; the whole UCAS application is read.

flagshipSource.title: Edinburgh School of Informatics: the largest in the UK, with over 280 academic and research staff

programmes.name: Veterinary Medicine (5-year programme)
programmes.about: Five years to become a vet at the Royal (Dick) School of Veterinary Studies on the Easter Bush campus: how the animal body works in years 1 and 2, then species, disease and treatment, ending in clinical rotations in its own hospitals.
programmes.ib: Offers in recent years went to 38 points with 666 at HL, including Chemistry 6 and Biology 6 at HL, and English SL 5. Every grade must be a first attempt.

needs.note: GCSE English at B or 6 is also accepted

programmes.selectionNote: Competitive applicants are interviewed between December and March, around 600 a year; offers go on interview performance. Work experience counts.

flagshipSource.title: Veterinary Medicine BVM&S: its campus and three on-site veterinary hospitals (programme benefits)

programmes.name: Philosophy
programmes.about: An undergraduate MA in thinking clearly about the great questions, from mind, language and science to ethics and politics, with more than 40 option courses in years 3 and 4. Philosophy has been taught here since 1583.
programmes.ib: Offers in recent years ran from 36 points with 665 at HL to 34 with 655. No HL subject is required; English SL 5.
programmes.selectionNote: Meeting the requirements puts you in selection; the whole UCAS application is read, personal statement included.

flagshipSource.title: Philosophy MA (Hons): taught since 1583, at the centre of the Scottish Enlightenment (programme benefits)

faculties.name: College of Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences
faculties.line: Your personal statement must show commitment to the subject you apply for.

faculties.name: College of Science and Engineering
faculties.line: Two applications at most across the college, and only one in Informatics, Physics or Maths.

faculties.name: College of Medicine and Veterinary Medicine
faculties.line: Medicine closes on 15 October; shortlisted applicants attend a half-day of short interviews.

notes: EU students pay the International/EU rate, for example £31,100 a year for Ancient History in 2027/8, fixed for all four years of the degree.
The IB grades on each degree page are what most successful applicants had in recent years; for highly selective degrees Edinburgh may only consider applicants who exceed them.
Edinburgh estimates £1,546 a month to live in the city as a single undergraduate in 2026-27.
